Observed usage never exceeded the normal team limit

Last-slot race saves and charges exactly one answer

Duplicate in-flight submissions return success plus conflict or the same completed result

Concurrent duplicates use one reservation, one saved answer and one charge
Changed question with an old idempotency key is rejected

limitations: A real model answer is checked on a small synthetic example, not a broad model-safety corpus.
Actual vendor call counts/billing are not measured; quota assertions inspect real PostgreSQL ledger rows.
Previously downloaded bytes/screenshots cannot be recalled by revocation.
salaryProvisioning: Existing original preserved and checked against the synthetic fixture.
